ersinkoc/phonebox.caption:
Don't throw away your old Android phone 📱 Turn it into a desk panel for your computer.

PhoneBox is a small Android app plus an agent for Windows, Linux or macOS. Your old phone becomes a full-screen panel with widgets for your PC, your AI coding sessions, music and weather.
